rules.alternatives: No general CE hours: APRN renewal requires current national certification in the role and population focus. The 3 hours apply only to APRNs with prescriptive authority.

topics.who: APRNs with prescriptive authority: responsible prescribing of controlled substances or treatment of substance use disorders; certificate uploaded with the renewal application

rules.notes: All nursing licenses renew biennially in even years; the 2026 renewal window is Oct 1 to Dec 31. Fees: $180 for the first national certification, $70 per additional certification, $70 for prescriptive authority.
rules.legal_basis: W.S. §33-21-129 (Nurse Practice Act); WSBN Rules Chapter 2
